verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs clearly show a typed-property system (custom Object Types, docs-32/38), Queries that filter/organize by criteria (docs-8/21), Templates (docs-13/22) and Graph/Links for retrieval (docs-9/28/40), which together deliver structured, typed organization and retrieval. However, there is no explicit mention of 'tags' as a first-class concept (only Types/Relations), and community feedback (anytype-comm-4, anytype-comm-5) notes that the relationships/sets system became 'too complicated' for casual use and that graph view is 'totally useless' once you have hundreds of objects, indicating real friction at scale for power users. missing for 10: explicit tag feature documentation, independent hands-on validation that property-based retrieval scales well for large note collections.
